prompt: Any energy anomalies this week? Put a cost on them.
expected_response: Reference: see rubrics for scenario S4.
actual_response:
Three energy anomalies were detected this week (2026-08-13 to 2026-08-19) with the following costs and impacts:

* **Compressor Specific Power Drift (AC-04):** Specific power drifted to 7.114 kW/(Nm3/min), which is 16.6% higher than the peer median of 6.103 kW/(Nm3/min) [melco_edge_to_grid_demo.compressor_perf]. The compressor draws an extra 41.2 kW while running. The annualized cost of this excess energy is 10,065,059 JPY (based on 329,412 kWh per year at 30.55 JPY/kWh) [melco_edge_to_grid_demo.jepx_prices_30min, melco_edge_to_grid_demo.tariff_contract]. The recommendation is to run AC-04 on standby and inspect for leaks.
* **Stuck Sub-meter (M-27 on Line LN-02):** The meter reading remained frozen at 696.5 kW for 51.9 hours up to today at 13:25 [melco_edge_to_grid_demo.telemetry_5min, melco_edge_to_grid_demo.meters]. This resulted in 51.4 kW of unallocated load, representing 2,667 kWh of energy worth 81,479 JPY. DR settlement is unaffected, but sub-meter measurement and verification for gain-share line items is blocked [gain_share_agreement_summary.md Section 4]. The recommendation is to reset the meter communication module.
* **Billing Demand Peak around DR Event (BESS-01):** A monthly billing peak of 14,643.7 kW was recorded on 2026-08-06 16:30 in the 2 hours preceding DR event DR-20260806 [melco_edge_to_grid_demo.site_load_30min]. The battery provided 0 kW output because it was held full for the event. This added 710.1 kW to the monthly billing demand, incurring an extra demand charge of 1,065,116 JPY this month at 1,500 JPY/kW-month [melco_edge_to_grid_demo.tariff_contract]. The recommendation is to transition to forecast_aware_v2 logic to co-optimize state of charge for DR events and peak shaving.
